handbookNote: *** CRITICAL, READ FIRST: A TIME-LIMITED SCOPE THAT WILL CHANGE JULY 1, 2027. *** The 2026 Virginia General Assembly has ALREADY ENACTED HB163/SB316 (2026 Acts of Assembly, cc. 364-365), creating a brand-new Code of Virginia section, Sec. 47.1-5.2, and amending Secs. 47.1-5, 47.1-5.1, and 47.1-8 to cross-reference it -- EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2027 -- confirmed directly from the official code database (law.lis.virginia.gov), which displays 'current' and '(Effective July 1, 2027)' text side by side for each amended section. Starting that date: (1) NEW-commission applicants must complete a 4-hour course of instruction (notarial laws, best practices/procedures, and verification of identity), of which 1 HOUR must specifically cover REAL ESTATE FRAUD AND FINANCIAL EXPLOITATION OF ELDERLY PERSONS, taken in the 6 months before applying, PLUS pass a WRITTEN EXAMINATION to the satisfaction of the Secretary; and (2) every RECOMMISSION applicant must complete a 2-HOUR refresher course (same subject mix) each time they recommission, though no exam is required for recommission.
